page_description: Live configuration status for the store and its integrated services.
status_loaded: Status from the running backend configuration.
email_missing: Email sending is not fully configured
groups_description: Select a group to view non-sensitive values and credential status.
section_value_description: Active values from the frontend or backend, depending on the setting.
replace_secret_placeholder: Enter only to rotate this secret
email_secret_notice: Email credentials are shown by status only. Newly entered values remain in this form and are not sent or saved.
vnpay_secret_notice: The hash secret cannot be retrieved. VNPay configuration is initialized when the backend starts and requires a safe deployment workflow to change.
account_invalid: Account configuration is invalid or incomplete
tunnel_dns_unmanaged_title: Tunnel and DNS are not managed by the app
tunnel_dns_unmanaged_description: Cloudflare API access and tunnel-agent updates are not integrated. This page does not make DNS changes.
cloudflare_secret_notice: Access keys, secret keys, and API tokens are never returned by the backend.
secret_never_returned: Secrets are never returned to the browser
filtered_response_notice: The API returns only configuration status and filtered operational data.
empty_data: No data to display. Reload configuration status.
runtime_read_only: Runtime configuration is read-only · no changes are being written.
status_color_description: Red means danger, yellow means warning, and green means good. Existing secrets cannot be retrieved; the eye button only applies to newly entered values.
live_backend_title: Information is read directly from the backend
secret_safety_notice: Passwords and tokens show configuration status only; existing values are never sent to the browser. Editing is unavailable until an encrypted secret store and safe reload workflow are in place.
load_error_hint: Check the backend connection and Super Admin access, then try again.
super_admin_only: Only Super Admin accounts can access this area.
